To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a Stein's unbiased risk estimator (SURE) based training method that only with noisy input training data was able to achieve high quality denoising performance comparable with that of the original mean squared error (mse) based deep learning denoising networks.

we proposed a Stein's Unbiasied Risk Estimator (SUR) based method for deep learning based denoising without ground truth data, and demonstrated that our method only with noisy data was able to achieve performance close to that with ground truth data.

(1) SURE can be used to train deep learning based denoising network without ground truth data, (2) SURE based training of denoisers with noisy data only yields performance close to that achieved by MSE based training of denoising networks with ground truth data, and (3) SURE based denoising can also be used to train denoising networks in an end-to-end fashion.
